description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that delivers Express‑style simplicity with AI‑first hooks, edge‑runtime speed, and native server‑less deployment.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the surge in AI‑augmented back‑ends and edge‑compute by positioning yantravese as the only **zero‑dependency**, **type‑safe** framework that lets you drop in LLM hooks, run on Cloudflare Workers, Bun, Deno, or WASM with no extra bundles. Highlight the built‑in OpenTelemetry, observable API, and native server‑less adapters to capture the 2026 trend of ultra‑light, observability‑first micro‑services.
download_hooks: Developers pick yantravese for **instant AI hook integration** – add LLM‑driven routes with a single line of TypeScript, no extra packages.
Performance: **Edge‑runtime latency under 2 ms** on Cloudflare Workers and Bun, thanks to a zero‑dependency core and native WASM support.
Developer experience: **Strict TypeScript out‑of‑the‑box**, observable API for live debugging, and one‑click deployment to any server‑less platform (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare).
